items.text: Aircraft maintenance engineering leads to roles in airlines and maintenance organisations where licensed engineers certify that aircraft are safe, and the route depends on approved training, examinations and logged experience under the aviation regulator, which makes checking approval essential before paying fees.
Verify approval, understand the exam and log requirements and prepare for demanding, safety-critical work.
Approved institutes, licence categories, eligibility and examination rules are set by the aviation regulator and change.
